spec_match.rationale: Runs the real Iterator.zip (native on this build) in all three modes over the same editable sources, including longest-mode padding and the strict-mode TypeError.

interactive.rationale: Three source inputs, padding input and focus select all re-run the three-way comparison and the step table live (verified via inputs and select).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb says the only way to choose between modes is to see them disagree, and the page runs all three simultaneously.

edge_cases.rationale: Strict-mode throw shown at the exact step, quiet-ignore of padding under non-longest modes called out as the API's one silent failure, 200-step cap.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 8/8 pass natively here, covering zip/zipKeyed surfaces, shortest default, padding, strict TypeError and iterator closing.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Native banner confirmed; modes diverged correctly on ragged defaults; console clean; mobile screenshot clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: modes-diverge asserts the literal true rather than, e.g., shortest<=longest step counts.

design_system.rationale: Mode cards with amber selection outline, variables throughout.

accessibility.rationale: All inputs labelled, aria-live detail, visible focus 12/12.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow at 360×740; mode cards stack cleanly (screenshot inspected).

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. Native Iterator.zip confirmed; the three-mode disagreement design teaches the API's core choice with real executions, including the strict TypeError.
